intro: Breaking the Breaker is a desperate military strike against Commander Belguilos, a terrifying former peacekeeper who now leads a dangerous cult assault in the Gustberry Lowlands. Eliminating her at her hillside villa offers the beleaguered defenders their only real chance of surviving the onslaught.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... Off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.
I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, adventurer.
We might just make it out of this alive after all.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
